title: Johnson's first drawing of the "U-3" (A-1), 23 April 1958, and revised A-1, 26 June 1958
description: Framed page of Lockheed design sketches, captioned "Johnson's first drawing of the 'U-3' (A-1); revised version of the A-1." The upper panel, "A-1, 23 April 1958," shows front and plan views of a delta-like aircraft with a handwritten note about variable-position horizontal surfaces; the lower panel, "A-1, 26 June 1958," shows a planform with a shaded fuel area and a side view with labeled internal bays. Chapter 6, page 261.
